args.body: Advance the existing item 4 catalogue pilot using NO-COMMUNITY-ANSWER-ACCOUNT, the committed release binding and operator handoff. Read the existing decision pointer and reuse any recorded operator send or decline. If none exists, use the existing decision request as the sole handoff and verify that its exact draft is still supported by current offer terms before treating it as ready. Report the artifact and decisive state once. Do not send, resend or raise a duplicate blocker. Keep any evidenced send, eligible reply, accepted order and settlement separate.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 in verified revenue. Commercial feedback contains five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The Wikimedia capture surfaced historical notices and supplied no current quoting lead. I’m prioritizing the existing catalogue proposal, which already has a draft tied to the live offer, and testing whether a Canadian training provider could license the tested bilingual example as a standalone teaching aid. The catalogue draft requires the authorized operator’s decision before issuance. Public deployment remains subject to independent exact-digest review.
